find: the prosecution fails on both \emph{mens rea} (collateral effect vs.\ specific intent to aid an enemy) and \emph{imminence} (a vague call for a strike ``next month'' lacks immediate lawless incitement).
replace: the prosecution fails under \emph{Brandenburg} because the call is not directed to producing imminent lawless action. Holmes separately distinguished a purpose to obstruct the United States' war effort from a merely collateral effect of protesting American policy abroad.
reason: Brandenburg never requires specific intent to aid an enemy. Holmes discussed whether defendants meant to hinder the United States' war effort rather than merely affect intervention in Russia.
